sets.title: Pip's Big Lift-Off
sets.logline: Pip, the one-eyed propeller puff from Propeller Pop, dreams of flying over Hilltop Town.

shots.title: Dreaming of the Sky
shots.line: At sunrise, Pip watches the sky islands drift over Hilltop Town.
shots.motionPrompt: Pip sits on the rooftop and gazes up, blinking its big eye, the little propeller twitching once; birds glide past the floating islands; slow gentle push-in.
